[1.60-3.30] Cinematic tracking shot, moving closer to the host who is now sitting gracefully in her gaming chair, she looks directly into the camera with a playful and charming smile, realistic facial muscle movement, natural blinking, neon glow and purple studio background light, Subtitle: "男人喝了女人受不了，"

[3.30-5.00] Low-angle shot, tight close-up on the host's face as she leans forward slightly with an expressive, mysterious, and engaging facial expression, her eyes sparkling, subtle head motion, dramatic vertical-drama pacing, atmospheric fog in the background, Subtitle: "配料有驴鞭，驴宝，驴肾脏，"

[5.00-6.60] Cinematic close-up, the host lifts a premium gold-labeled liquor bottle next to her face, keeping the product's height at exactly 60% of her face height to ensure perfect product visibility, she smiles confidently, product hero shot, ultra detailed texture of the golden bottle, Subtitle: "爸爸们还有十来种药食同源的原料，"

[6.60-8.30] Push-in shot, focus shifts to a tight close-up of the host's hands presenting the front of the premium golden liquor bottle, her finger pointing precisely at the ingredients on the label, natural hand interaction, luxury product cinematography, sharp focus on the glass texture and golden liquid, Subtitle: "今天买的都是我的亲爸爸。"

[8.30-10.00] Tracking shot, the host rotates the golden liquor bottle smoothly to showcase the detailed back label and barcode, realistic hand texture, golden hour lighting shining through the amber liquor inside the bottle, commercial lighting, high conversion potential, Subtitle: "各位爸爸，甘爹们，这可是好酒，"

[10.00-11.60] Medium close-up, the host sits back slightly, clapping her hands together enthusiastically to create a lively livestream atmosphere, her expression is full of joy and interaction, natural body motion, realistic skin texture, soft beauty light, Subtitle: "男人喝了女人受不了，"

[11.60-13.30] Over-the-shoulder shot, the host holds the golden liquor bottle elegantly in her left hand, presenting it toward the camera with an inviting and friendly smile, subtle breathing motion, high-end e-commerce livestream setup, cinematic depth of field, Subtitle: "配料有驴鞭，驴宝，驴肾脏，"

[13.30-15.00] Epic cinematic framing, final close-up of the host holding the bottle close to her chest, her right hand gently supporting it, she looks warmly at the audience with an appealing and persuasive expression, premium advertising composition, ending CTA, Subtitle: "爸爸们还有十来种药食同源的原料，今天买的都是我的亲爸爸。"

# SYSTEM OBJECTIVE
You are a master of visual layout. Your ONLY task is to generate a SINGLE image divided into a perfect 3x3 grid (9-box grid / 九宫格). 
Each grid cells represents one sequence scene from the user story.

# GRID & LAYOUT RULES
- COMPOSITION: The output MUST be a single image composed of exactly 9 equal-sized rectangular panels arranged in a 3x3 grid matrix (3 rows by 3 columns).
- NO TEXT ALLOWED: Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO subtitles, NO captions, NO watermarks, and NO labels inside or outside any of the 9 panels. Pure visuals only.
- PANEL SEPARATION: Use clean, thin lines to separate the 9 panels.

# REFERENCE ASSET SYSTEM
The uploaded images are fixed visual assets. These assets must remain consistent across all 9 panels.

## CHARACTER ASSETS
image1 = character 1 | image2 = character 2 | image3 = character 3 | image4 = character 4
image5 = character 5 | image6 = character 6 | image7 = character 7 | image8 = character 8
- Maintain: facial identity, body type, age, hairstyle, clothing style, skin tone across all panels.
- Do not merge, replace, or create new main characters.

## PRODUCT ASSET
If product images are uploaded, maintain identical: shape, color, material, texture, logo, package, label, branding.
- Never redesign or replace the product.
- PRODUCT VISIBILITY: The product must remain clearly visible in relevant panels (Recommended coverage: 30% to 60%).

## ENVIRONMENT ASSET
Background images define the visual style. Maintain: atmosphere, color palette, lighting mood, scene style. 
- Camera angle, composition, and lighting intensity may change between panels to show progression.

# STORY STRUCTURE (3x3 GRID MAPPING)
The 9 panels MUST exactly follow this sequential story progression:
[Panel 1: Top-Left] Scene 1: Attention hook.
[Panel 2: Top-Mid] Scene 2: Character emotion.
[Panel 3: Top-Right] Scene 3: Situation or problem.
[Panel 4: Mid-Left] Scene 4: Product introduction.
[Panel 5: Center] Scene 5: Selling point one.
[Panel 6: Mid-Right] Scene 6: Selling point two.
[Panel 7: Bottom-Left] Scene 7: Emotional connection.
[Panel 8: Bottom-Mid] Scene 8: Value reinforcement.
[Panel 9: Bottom-Right] Scene 9: Call to action.

# CHARACTER BEHAVIOR & CAMERA
- Use natural actions: walking, sitting, smiling, talking, holding/using product. One main action per panel.
- Avoid: repeated waving, exaggerated acting, robotic movement.
- Camera: Use diverse framing (push in, pull out, pan, tilt, tracking) across different panels to keep the grid dynamic.

# INPUT DATA
USER STORY: {{USER_SCRIPT}}
USER SELLING POINTS: {{SELLING_POINTS}}
TARGET AUDIENCE: {{TARGET_AUDIENCE}}
EMOTIONAL STYLE: {{EMOTION}}

# OUTPUT
Output a single image containing the 3x3 grid style, strictly following the rules above. NO TEXT/SUBTITLES AT ALL.时长：15秒。
